Tata letak layar besar Facebook yang lebih lebar hilang. Mati secara bawaan, karena belum dicoba di layar besar. Mulai ulang Facebook untuk melihat perubahannya.

column2: Kartu dan menu memakai warna halaman itu sendiri, bukan warna hampir hitam yang membuatnya menonjol. Tombol dan kolom pencarian tetap berisi abu-abu gelap agar tetap terlihat. Mulai ulang Facebook untuk melihat perubahannya.

column1: People looking at a post don't see that you're writing a comment.
column2: Orang yang melihat postingan tidak melihat bahwa kamu sedang menulis komentar.

column1: Hide read receipts
column2: Sembunyikan tanda dibaca

column1: People you chat with in Facebook's own chats can't see that you've read their messages. The chat can stay unread on this phone.
column2: Orang yang chat denganmu di chat Facebook sendiri tidak bisa melihat bahwa kamu sudah membaca pesan mereka. Chat bisa tetap belum dibaca di ponsel ini.

column1: Facebook can't tell when you take a screenshot or record your screen, so it can't react.
column2: Facebook tidak tahu saat kamu mengambil tangkapan layar atau merekam layar, jadi tidak bisa bereaksi.

column1: Stops sending Facebook your list of watched reels. It uses the list to rank your feed, so reels you've watched may come back.
column2: Berhenti mengirim daftar reel yang sudah kamu tonton ke Facebook. Facebook memakainya untuk menyusun feed kamu, jadi reel yang sudah ditonton bisa muncul lagi.

column1: # context: switch title under Reels and Watch; the Reels tab shows the most recently posted reels before older ones
Newest reels first
column2: Reel terbaru dulu

column1: # context: summary of that switch; "loaded" means the reels the app has already downloaded in the background, "placed" means reels already lined up as the next ones
# context: what stays in while Hushfacebook is paused, shown before the patch's name in brackets; the patch raises the app's version number so Google Play never offers an update
Meta's apps can install beside this one
column2: Aplikasi Meta bisa dipasang berdampingan

column1: Messenger, Facebook Lite, Business Suite and Workplace can install next to this Facebook. Their shared permissions no longer clash.
column2: Messenger, Facebook Lite, Business Suite, dan Workplace bisa dipasang berdampingan dengan Facebook ini. Izin yang mereka bagi tidak lagi bentrok.

column1: # context: settings section heading for the Open on a chosen tab rows
Opening Facebook
column2: Saat Facebook dibuka

column1: # context: switch title; the list below it picks the tab
Open on a chosen tab
column2: Buka di tab pilihan

column1: Choose where Facebook opens from its icon. Notifications and links still open their destination.
column2: Pilih tab saat Facebook dibuka dari ikonnya. Notifikasi dan tautan tetap membuka tujuannya.

column1: # context: title of the list of tabs Facebook can open on
Tab to open on
column2: Tab saat dibuka

Home

column2: Feed

column1: Video
column2: Video

column1: Friends
column2: Teman

column1: Marketplace
column2: Marketplace

Events
column2: Acara

column1: Notifications
column2: Notifikasi

column1: Menu
column2: Menu

column1: # context: summary of the tab list; %1$s is one of the tab names above
Facebook opens on %1$s. If your tab bar doesn't have it, Facebook opens on Home.
column2: Facebook terbuka di %1$s. Jika bilah tab tidak memilikinya, Facebook terbuka di Beranda.

column1: # context: summary of the tab list when Feeds is picked; off the tab bar, Feeds opens as its own page over Home
Facebook opens on Feeds. If your tab bar doesn't have it, the Feeds page opens over Home.
column2: Facebook terbuka di Feed. Jika bilah tab tidak memilikinya, halaman Feed terbuka di atas Beranda.

column1: # context: a sentence in the settings import preview and its toast; %1$s is a tab name
Facebook will open on %1$s.
column2: Facebook akan terbuka di %1$s.

column1: # context: switch title under Opening Facebook; Following is Facebook's feed of the friends, Pages and groups you follow, and Home is the tab
Following feed on Home
column2: Feed Diikuti di Beranda

column1: # context: summary of that switch; the ranked feed is the one Facebook orders for you, and the Feeds tab has its own filters
Home shows the newest posts from friends, groups and Pages you follow, like All in the Feeds tab, or the filter you pick below. The Feeds tab's filters don't change.
column2: Beranda menampilkan postingan terbaru dari teman, grup, dan Halaman yang kamu ikuti, seperti Semua di tab Feed atau filter yang kamu pilih di bawah. Filter di tab Feed tidak berubah.

column1: Jump to a section
column2: Lompat ke bagian

column1: Go straight to one group of settings. Back returns to where you were.
column2: Langsung ke satu kelompok setelan. Kembali membawamu ke tempat semula.

column1: # context: switch title under Downloads; on, every video save keeps to formats other apps accept
Save videos other apps can open
column2: Simpan video yang bisa dibuka aplikasi lain

column1: # context: summary of that switch; WhatsApp is a name and stays as it is, and saves are the videos the user saved to the phone
Fixes saved videos that play without sound in WhatsApp, video editors such as CapCut and InShot, or some galleries and players. May lower quality.
column2: Memperbaiki video tersimpan yang diputar tanpa suara di WhatsApp, editor video seperti CapCut dan InShot, atau beberapa galeri dan pemutar. Bisa menurunkan kualitas.

column1: # context: title of a switch under Downloads; convert means re-encoding the video on the phone
Convert to keep the full size
column2: Konversi agar tetap ukuran penuh

column1: # context: summary of that switch; Save videos other apps can open is the switch above it, VP9, AV1 and H.264 are video formats and stay as they are

With Save videos other apps can open on, a full size video Facebook only has as VP9 or AV1 is converted to H.264 on your phone instead of saved smaller. Slower, and videos over 10 minutes stay smaller.
column2: Saat Simpan video yang bisa dibuka aplikasi lain aktif, video ukuran penuh yang di Facebook hanya ada sebagai VP9 atau AV1 dikonversi ke H.264 di ponselmu, bukan disimpan lebih kecil. Lebih lambat, dan video lebih dari 10 menit tetap lebih kecil.

column1: # context: switch title under Downloads; on, a save shows no message when it starts, finishes or is canceled
Quiet saves
column2: Simpan tanpa pesan

column1: # context: summary of that switch; a toast is Android's short message at the bottom of the screen
No toast when a save starts, finishes or is canceled. A save that fails still says why.
column2: Tidak ada pesan saat penyimpanan dimulai, selesai, atau dibatalkan. Jika gagal, alasannya tetap ditampilkan.

column1: # context: section title for the Chats settings, named like Facebook's own Chats screen
Chats
column2: Chat

column1: # context: switch title under Chats; the card is Facebook's own "Get the Messenger app" card
Hide the Get Messenger card
column2: Sembunyikan kartu Dapatkan Messenger

column1: # context: summary of that switch; Messenger is the app's name and stays as it is
Hides the card at the top of Chats that asks you to get Messenger, once Messenger is installed. Without Messenger, the card stays.
column2: Menyembunyikan kartu di atas Chat yang mengajak kamu memasang Messenger, jika Messenger sudah terpasang. Tanpa Messenger, kartu itu tetap ada.

column1: # context: switch title under Chats; the notes and active now row is the row of friends' notes and who's active above the chat list in Chats inside Facebook
Hide the notes and active now row
column2: Sembunyikan baris catatan dan yang aktif

column1: # context: summary of that switch
Removes the row above your chats that shows friends' notes and who's active. Your own note tile may go too. Your chats stay.
column2: Menghapus baris di atas chat kamu yang menampilkan catatan teman dan siapa yang sedang aktif. Kotak catatan milikmu bisa ikut hilang. Chat kamu tetap ada.

column1: # context: switch title under Chats; promotions are the banners Facebook puts at the top of the chat list
Hide chat list promotions
column2: Sembunyikan promosi di daftar obrolan

column1: # context: summary of that switch
Hides the banners at the top of Chats, like the one asking you to turn on notifications.
column2: Menyembunyikan spanduk di atas Chat, seperti yang meminta kamu menyalakan notifikasi.

column1: # context: switch title under Chats; Meta AI is Meta's assistant and keeps its name; the button sits beside the search box at the top of Chats and on Chats' search screen
Hide the Meta AI button in Chats
column2: Sembunyikan tombol Meta AI di Chat

column1: # context: summary of that switch; your chats with Meta AI are conversations with the assistant, which stay in the list
Removes the Meta AI button beside the search box in Chats, at the top of the list and on the search screen. The search box stays, and so do your chats with Meta AI.
column2: Menghapus tombol Meta AI di samping kotak pencarian di Chat, di atas daftar dan di layar pencarian. Kotak pencarian tetap ada, begitu juga obrolan kamu dengan Meta AI.

column1: # context: switch title under Chats; on, Facebook's Messenger icon opens the Messenger app
Open the Messenger app
column2: Buka aplikasi Messenger

column1: # context: summary of that switch; Messenger is the app's name, Chats is Facebook's own chat screen as named above
Tapping the Messenger icon at the top of Facebook opens the Messenger app instead of Chats. Without Messenger, Chats opens as before.
column2: Mengetuk ikon Messenger di bagian atas Facebook membuka aplikasi Messenger, bukan Chat. Tanpa Messenger, Chat terbuka seperti biasa.

column1: # context: switch title under Chats; on, Facebook leaves ringing for calls and notifying about chats to the Messenger app
Leave calls and chats to Messenger
column2: Serahkan panggilan dan chat ke Messenger

column1: # context: summary of that switch; signed out means not logged in to the Messenger app, turned off means the app is disabled in Android's settings

Facebook leaves calls and chat notifications to Messenger while Messenger is installed and enabled. Restart Facebook after changing this switch, or after installing, removing, enabling or disabling Messenger, so call routing updates. If you're signed out of Messenger, you'll miss calls and messages.
column2: Facebook menyerahkan panggilan dan notifikasi chat ke Messenger selama Messenger terpasang dan aktif. Mulai ulang Facebook setelah mengubah sakelar ini, atau setelah memasang, menghapus, mengaktifkan, atau menonaktifkan Messenger, agar perutean panggilan diperbarui. Jika kamu keluar dari Messenger, kamu akan melewatkan panggilan dan pesan.

column1: # context: settings section heading for the Tap to play switch
Playback
column2: Pemutaran

column1: # context: switch title; on, videos and music wait for a tap before they play
Tap to play
column2: Ketuk untuk memutar

column1: # context: summary of that switch; Autoplay and Off are the name and value of Facebook's own setting, as Facebook shows them in this language
Videos, reels, stories and music wait for your tap instead of playing by themselves. Facebook's own Autoplay setting shows Off while this is on.
column2: Video, reel, cerita, dan musik menunggu ketukanmu, tidak diputar sendiri. Pengaturan Putar otomatis milik Facebook menampilkan Mati selama ini menyala.

column1: # context: switch title under Opening Facebook; Marketplace is Facebook's tab and keeps its name
Marketplace only
column2: Hanya Marketplace

column1: # context: switch title under Opening Facebook, next to Marketplace only; Events is Facebook's tab and keeps its name
Events only
column2: Hanya Acara

column1: # context: summary of that switch; the tab names are Facebook's own, as its tab bar shows them
# context: switch title under Menu; Upgrades is the name of a section in Facebook's own Menu
Hide Upgrades
column2: Sembunyikan “Upgrade”

column1: # context: summary of that switch; Settings and Help and support are Facebook's own Menu sections
The Upgrades section and its offers leave Facebook's Menu. Settings, Help and support and the rest of the Menu stay.
column2: Bagian “Upgrade” dan penawarannya hilang dari Menu Facebook. Pengaturan, Bantuan & dukungan, dan bagian Menu lainnya tetap ada.

column1: # context: switch title under Menu; Also from Meta is the name of a section in Facebook's own Menu
Hide Also from Meta
column2: Sembunyikan “Juga dari Meta”

column1: Hide the Muse card
column2: Sembunyikan kartu Muse

column1: The Muse card, Meta's ad for its AI agent app, leaves the top of Facebook's Menu.
column2: Kartu Muse, iklan Meta untuk aplikasi agen AI-nya, hilang dari bagian atas Menu Facebook.

column1: # context: summary of that switch; the section links to Meta's other apps and shows ads for its devices
The Also from Meta section leaves Facebook's Menu, with its links to Meta's other apps and its ads for Meta's devices. Your own shortcuts stay.
column2: Bagian “Juga dari Meta” hilang dari Menu Facebook, beserta tautannya ke aplikasi Meta lainnya dan iklannya untuk perangkat Meta. Pintasanmu sendiri tetap ada.

column1: # context: switch title under Menu; Help and support is the name of a section in Facebook's own Menu
Hide Help and support
column2: Sembunyikan “Bantuan & dukungan”

column1: # context: summary of that switch; Settings and privacy is Facebook's own Menu section
The Help and support section leaves Facebook's Menu, header and all. Settings and privacy stays.
column2: Bagian “Bantuan & dukungan” hilang dari Menu Facebook, beserta judulnya. “Pengaturan dan privasi” tetap ada.

column1: # context: switch title under Menu; Settings and privacy is a section of Facebook's own Menu that folds and unfolds when its header is tapped
Keep Settings and privacy expanded
column2: Biarkan “Pengaturan dan privasi” terbuka

column1: # context: summary of that switch
Settings and privacy in Facebook's Menu stays open, so its rows show without a tap.
column2: “Pengaturan dan privasi” tetap terbuka di Menu Facebook, jadi barisnya terlihat tanpa perlu diketuk.

column1: # context: section title for the search settings, named like Facebook's own search
Search
column2: Pencarian

column1: # context: switch title under Search; Meta AI is Meta's assistant and keeps its name
Hide Meta AI in search
column2: Sembunyikan Meta AI di pencarian

column1: # context: summary of that switch; Meta AI and Ask Meta AI are Meta's own names, as Facebook shows them
Search no longer shows Meta AI answers or Ask Meta AI prompts, or sends your search to Meta AI. Results for people, groups, pages and posts stay.
column2: Pencarian tidak lagi menampilkan jawaban Meta AI atau ajakan Ask Meta AI, dan tidak mengirim pencarianmu ke Meta AI. Hasil untuk orang, grup, halaman, dan postingan tetap ada.

column1: # context: settings section heading for the Default comment order switch and its list
# context: switch title; on, a post's comments open in the order chosen in the list below it
Default comment order
column2: Urutan komentar bawaan

column1: # context: summary of that switch; a link to a comment is one from a notification, say
Use the order below. A choice made on a post lasts until restart. Links to comments keep Facebook's order.
column2: Gunakan urutan di bawah. Pilihan pada postingan berlaku hingga mulai ulang. Tautan komentar mempertahankan urutan Facebook.

column1: # context: switch title under Comments; Meta AI writes a short summary of what a post's comments say
Hide Meta AI comment summaries
column2: Sembunyikan ringkasan komentar Meta AI

column1: # context: summary of that switch; the buttons are a post's Like, Comment and Share row
Hides Meta AI's summary at the top of comments and the comment summary under a post's buttons. The comments themselves stay.
column2: Menyembunyikan ringkasan Meta AI di bagian atas komentar dan ringkasan komentar di bawah tombol postingan. Komentarnya sendiri tetap ada.

column1: # context: switch title under Comments; the few comments Facebook shows under a post in the feed, below its Like, Comment and Share row
Hide comments under posts
column2: Sembunyikan komentar di bawah postingan

column1: # context: summary of that switch; Comment is the post's Comment button
Feed posts stop showing a few comments under their buttons. Tap Comment to read them all.
column2: Postingan di feed tidak lagi menampilkan komentar di bawah tombolnya. Ketuk Komentari untuk membaca semuanya.

column1: Hide dislike on comments
column2: Sembunyikan jempol ke bawah di komentar

column1: Takes the thumbs-down off comments. Like and Reply stay.
column2: Menghapus jempol ke bawah dari komentar. Suka dan Balas tetap ada.

column1: Hide Like on comments
column2: Sembunyikan Suka di komentar

column1: Takes Like off the row under comments. Reply and the reaction count stay.
column2: Menghapus Suka dari baris di bawah komentar. Balas dan jumlah reaksi tetap ada.

column1: # context: switch title under Comments; Like is the button under a post or a comment
Like only
column2: Hanya Suka

column1: # context: summary of that switch; the reactions are the row of Love, Haha, Wow and the rest that a long press on Like opens
A long press on Like doesn't open the reactions. A tap still likes.
column2: Menekan lama Suka tidak lagi membuka reaksi. Mengetuknya tetap memberi Suka.

column1: # context: switch title under Comments; GIF and sticker are two buttons in the box where you type a comment
Hide GIF and sticker buttons
column2: Sembunyikan tombol GIF dan stiker

column1: # context: summary of that switch; the comment box is where you type a comment
The comment box loses its GIF and sticker buttons. Typing, photos and posting work as before.
column2: Kotak komentar tidak lagi menampilkan tombol GIF dan stiker. Mengetik, foto, dan mengirim tetap berfungsi seperti biasa.

column1: # context: switch title under Comments: hides the Add a comment field at the bottom of the full-screen video viewer
Hide the video comment box
column2: Sembunyikan kotak komentar video

column1: The Add a comment box under a full-screen video goes away. Comment boxes on posts stay.
column2: Kotak komentar di bawah video layar penuh hilang. Kotak komentar di postingan tetap ada.

column1: # context: switch title under Comments; a reply thread is the replies under a comment, which Facebook folds behind View replies
Open every reply thread
column2: Buka semua utas balasan

column1: # context: summary of that switch; View replies is the link Facebook shows under a comment that has replies
Comments show their replies right away, so there's no View replies to tap.
column2: Komentar langsung menampilkan balasannya, jadi tidak perlu mengetuk Lihat balasan.

column1: # context: switch title under Comments; it makes an open reply thread load the rest of its replies by itself as the list is scrolled
Load whole reply threads
column2: Muat utas balasan lengkap

column1: # context: summary of that switch; View more replies is the row Facebook shows under an open thread that has more replies to load
An open reply thread keeps loading as you scroll, so there's no View more replies to tap.
column2: Utas balasan yang terbuka terus dimuat saat kamu menggulir, tanpa perlu mengetuk untuk melihat balasan lainnya.

column1: Hide replies button
column2: Tombol Sembunyikan balasan

column1: An open reply thread gets a Hide replies button, so you can close it again after reading.
column2: Utas balasan yang terbuka mendapat tombol Sembunyikan balasan, jadi kamu bisa menutupnya lagi setelah membaca.

column1: Hide replies
column2: Sembunyikan balasan

column1: # context: switch title under Comments; View more replies is the row under an open reply thread that loads more replies, and this makes the whole row take the tap instead of only its words
Tap anywhere on View more replies
column2: Ketuk di mana saja pada Lihat balasan lainnya

column1: # context: summary of that switch
The whole View more replies row opens the replies, not just its words.
column2: Seluruh baris Lihat balasan lainnya membuka balasan, bukan hanya teksnya.

column1: Hide related groups
column2: Sembunyikan grup terkait

column1: A group post's comments end without the Related groups list and its Join buttons.
column2: Komentar postingan grup berakhir tanpa daftar Grup terkait dan tombol Gabung-nya.

column1: # context: row title under Comments that opens Facebook's own settings; reaction counts are the numbers next to the reactions on a post
Hide reaction counts
column2: Sembunyikan jumlah reaksi

column1: # context: summary of that row; Preferences and Reaction preferences are the names Facebook's own settings use
Facebook has its own setting for this. Open Facebook's settings, then Preferences and Reaction preferences.
column2: Facebook punya pengaturan sendiri untuk ini. Buka pengaturan Facebook, lalu Preferensi dan Preferensi reaksi.

column1: # context: message shown when Facebook's own settings could not be opened from that row
Facebook's settings didn't open. You'll find Reaction preferences in its Settings, under Preferences.
column2: Pengaturan Facebook tidak terbuka. Preferensi reaksi ada di Pengaturan Facebook, di bawah Preferensi.

column1: # context: title of the list of comment orders, and of its dialog
Comment order
column2: Urutan komentar

column1: # context: entry of that list: the order Facebook's servers pick, which is what happens without Hushfacebook
Facebook's choice
column2: Pilihan Facebook

column1: # context: entry of that list; Facebook's own name for this order in the sort menu of a post's comments
Most relevant
column2: Paling relevan

column1: # context: entry of that list; Facebook's own name for this order in the sort menu of a post's comments
Newest
column2: Terbaru

column1: # context: entry of that list; Facebook's own name for this order in the sort menu of a post's comments
All comments
column2: Semua komentar

column1: # context: summary of the list when Facebook's choice is picked; Most relevant is Facebook's own name for that order
Comments open in the order Facebook picks, which is usually Most relevant.
column2: Komentar dibuka dengan urutan yang dipilih Facebook, biasanya Paling relevan.

column1: # context: summary of the list; %1$s is one of the order names above, as Facebook's sort menu shows it
A post's comments open with %1$s picked in their sort menu, where the post offers it.
column2: Komentar sebuah postingan dibuka dengan %1$s terpilih di menu urutannya, jika postingan itu menyediakannya.

column1: # context: sentence in the import preview and the toast after an import that sets the comment order to Facebook's choice
Comments will open in the order Facebook picks.
column2: Komentar akan dibuka dengan urutan yang dipilih Facebook.

column1: # context: sentence in the import preview and the toast after an import that sets the comment order; %1$s is one of the order names above
Comments will open with %1$s picked in their sort menu.
column2: Komentar akan dibuka dengan %1$s terpilih di menu urutannya.

column1: # context: switch title under Search; the ads Facebook puts between search results
Hide sponsored search results
column2: Sembunyikan hasil pencarian bersponsor

column1: # context: summary of that switch
Hides ads between your search results. The results you searched for stay.
column2: Menyembunyikan iklan di antara hasil pencarianmu. Hasil yang kamu cari tetap ada.

column1: # context: switch title under News feed; the ads between the posts on a person's profile or a Page
Hide sponsored profile posts
column2: Sembunyikan postingan bersponsor di profil

column1: # context: summary of that switch; Page is Facebook's name for a business or public figure's page
Hides ads between posts on someone's profile or a Page. Their own posts stay.
column2: Menyembunyikan iklan di antara postingan pada profil seseorang atau sebuah Halaman. Postingan mereka sendiri tetap ada.

column1: # context: switch title under News feed; a note is the short text bubble (or a 'Drop a thought' prompt) Facebook shows over a person's profile picture
Hide profile notes
column2: Sembunyikan catatan profil

column1: # context: summary of that switch
Hides the note bubble that sits on profile pictures. Applies the next time you open a profile.
column2: Menyembunyikan gelembung catatan di atas foto profil. Berlaku saat kamu membuka profil berikutnya.

column1: # context: switch title under News feed; Save is Facebook's own button that keeps a post in your saved items
Save button under posts
column2: Tombol Simpan di bawah postingan

column1: # context: summary of that switch; Like, Comment and Share are the buttons under a post
Adds Facebook's own Save button next to Like, Comment and Share under posts. A saved post shows its bookmark filled in.
column2: Menambahkan tombol Simpan milik Facebook di samping Suka, Komentari, dan Bagikan di bawah postingan. Postingan yang disimpan menampilkan penanda yang terisi.

column1: # context: switch title under News feed; a button that saves a post's video or photos to the phone
Download button under posts
column2: Tombol Unduh di bawah postingan

column1: # context: summary of that switch; Downloads is the name of Hushfacebook's settings page for saving media
Adds a Download button under posts with a video or photos. It saves the video, the photo, or every photo of an album, using the Downloads settings.
column2: Menambahkan tombol Unduh di bawah postingan yang berisi video atau foto. Tombol ini menyimpan video, foto, atau setiap foto dalam album dengan pengaturan Unduhan.

column1: # context: switch title under News feed; Like is Facebook's own button under a post
Hide Like under posts
column2: Sembunyikan Suka di bawah postingan

column1: # context: switch title under News feed; Comment is Facebook's own button under a post
Hide Comment under posts
column2: Sembunyikan Komentari di bawah postingan

column1: # context: switch title under News feed; Share is Facebook's own button under a post
Hide Share under posts
column2: Sembunyikan Bagikan di bawah postingan

column1: # context: switch title under News feed; Send is Facebook's own button under a post that sends it in a chat
Hide Send under posts
column2: Sembunyikan Kirim di bawah postingan

column1: # context: summary shared by those four switches
Takes this button out of the row under posts in the feed. The other buttons stay, and a post with all of its buttons hidden shows no row.
column2: Menghapus tombol ini dari baris di bawah postingan di feed. Tombol lainnya tetap ada, dan postingan yang semua tombolnya disembunyikan tidak menampilkan baris.

column1: # context: what stays in while Hushfacebook is paused, followed by the patch name in brackets; the row in Facebook's own Menu that opens Hushfacebook settings
# context: a short message when the Hushfacebook row in Facebook's Menu couldn't open the settings
Hushfacebook settings can't open here. Long-press the Facebook logo instead.
column2: Pengaturan Hushfacebook tidak bisa dibuka di sini. Tekan lama logo Facebook sebagai gantinya.

column1: # context: switch title under News feed; the row of groups Facebook suggests joining, shown between posts
Hide suggested groups
column2: Sembunyikan grup yang disarankan

column1: # context: summary of that switch; Discover more groups is the label of Facebook's own button under that row
Hides the row of groups to join between posts. Posts from groups you're in stay.
column2: Menyembunyikan baris grup untuk diikuti di antara postingan. Postingan dari grup yang sudah kamu ikuti tetap ada.

column1: # context: switch title under News feed; Facebook's own header of a row of Stories from people you don't know, shown between posts
Hide "Stories you might like"
column2: Sembunyikan “Cerita yang mungkin Anda sukai”

column1: Hide Memories in the feed
column2: Sembunyikan Kenangan di feed

column1: Hide friend requests in the feed
column2: Sembunyikan permintaan pertemanan di feed

column1: Hide friends' locations
column2: Sembunyikan lokasi teman

column1: # context: switch title under News feed, part of Hide suggested and promoted posts; a post opened by tapping a notification

column1: # context: switch title under Reels and Watch, part of Clean up Reels; each reel plays to its end one time and stops there instead of starting over
Play reels once
column2: Putar reel sekali saja

column1: # context: summary of that switch; "last frame" is the final picture of the video, which stays on screen

A reel stops on its last frame instead of starting over. Tap it to watch again, or swipe to the next one. Feed videos and stories aren't changed. Off by default, since it hasn't been tried on a real account yet.
column2: Reel berhenti di bingkai terakhirnya alih-alih diputar ulang dari awal. Ketuk untuk menonton lagi, atau geser ke reel berikutnya. Video di feed dan cerita tidak berubah. Mati secara bawaan, karena belum dicoba di akun sungguhan.

column1: # context: switch title under Reels and Watch, part of Clean up Reels; reels and videos play in the language they were recorded in instead of an audio track Facebook translated
Keep the original audio
column2: Pertahankan audio asli

column1: # context: summary of that switch; "dubbed" means the spoken audio was replaced by a translated voice; Meta AI is the company's AI assistant, keep the name
Reels and videos play with the sound they were made with, not a version Facebook dubbed into your language with Meta AI. Off by default, since it hasn't been tried on a real account yet.
column2: Reel dan video diputar dengan suara aslinya, bukan versi yang di-dubbing Facebook ke bahasamu dengan Meta AI. Mati secara bawaan, karena belum dicoba di akun sungguhan.

column1: # context: settings section title on the App page, above the switches of Hide Meta upsells; Meta is the company
Meta's other products
column2: Produk Meta lainnya

column1: # context: switch title; Edits is Meta's video editing app, keep its name
Hide Edits promotions
column2: Sembunyikan promosi Edits

column1: # context: switch title; Threads is Meta's app, keep its name; cross-posting means sharing a Facebook post to Threads as well
Hide Threads cross-posting prompts
column2: Sembunyikan ajakan membagikan ke Threads

column1: # context: switch title under Meta's other products; Threads is Meta's app, keep its name; the share sheet is the panel that opens when you tap Share on a post, use Facebook's own word for it in this language
Hide Threads in the share sheet
column2: Sembunyikan Threads di menu bagikan

column1: # context: switch title under Meta's other products; Muse is Meta's AI agent app, keep its name; the share sheet is the panel that opens when you tap Share on a post, use Facebook's own word for it in this language
Hide Muse in the share sheet
column2: Sembunyikan Muse di menu bagikan

column1: # context: switch title; Meta Verified is Meta's paid subscription, keep its name
Hide Meta Verified offers
column2: Sembunyikan penawaran Meta Verified

column1: # context: switch title; avatar stickers are stickers made from your Facebook avatar
Hide avatar sticker promotions
column2: Sembunyikan promosi stiker avatar

column1: # context: summary of the Edits switch; the pill is a small button under a video in the feed that opens Edits
Hides the Edits button in the Reels composer and the Edits pill under videos. You can still make reels in Facebook.
column2: Menyembunyikan tombol Edits di pembuat Reels dan label Edits di bawah video. Kamu tetap bisa membuat reel di Facebook.

column1: # context: summary of the Threads switch; the composer is where you write a new post
Facebook stops asking whether to share your post to Threads too. Posting to Facebook works as before.
column2: Facebook berhenti menanyakan apakah postinganmu mau dibagikan juga ke Threads. Memposting di Facebook berjalan seperti biasa.

column1: # context: summary of the Threads share sheet switch; the share sheet is the panel that opens when you tap Share on a post
Removes the Threads button when you share something. All other ways to share stay, in the same order.
column2: Menghapus tombol Threads saat kamu membagikan sesuatu. Cara berbagi lainnya tetap ada, dengan urutan yang sama.

column1: # context: summary of the Muse share sheet switch; Muse is Meta's AI agent app, keep its name
Removes Muse, Meta's AI agent app, when you share something. All other ways to share stay, in the same order.
column2: Menghapus Muse, aplikasi agen AI dari Meta, saat kamu membagikan sesuatu. Cara berbagi lainnya tetap ada, dengan urutan yang sama.

column1: # context: summary of the Meta Verified switch; the label is a line Facebook adds under the poster's name on some posts
No Meta Verified offer after you post, and no Meta Verified label under the names on posts. Posting works as usual.
column2: Tidak ada penawaran Meta Verified setelah kamu memposting, dan tidak ada label Meta Verified di bawah nama pada postingan. Memposting tetap berjalan seperti biasa.

column1: # context: summary of the avatar sticker switch; promotion slots are the cards Facebook uses to suggest its own features
Hides avatar sticker promotions in comments and elsewhere, and the prompt to make an avatar. Stickers still send.
column2: Menyembunyikan promosi stiker avatar di komentar dan tempat lain, serta ajakan membuat avatar. Stiker tetap bisa dikirim.

column1: # context: switch title under Meta's other products; Imagine is Meta AI's image maker, keep its name
Hide Meta AI's Imagine
column2: Sembunyikan Imagine dari Meta AI

column1: # context: switch title under Meta's other products; Meta AI is Meta's assistant and keeps its name; the buttons sit under some posts
Hide other Meta AI buttons under posts
column2: Sembunyikan tombol Meta AI lain di bawah postingan

column1: # context: summary of the Imagine switch; Imagine me is a button Facebook puts under some posts, keep its name; Create story is Facebook's screen for making a story, use Facebook's own name for it in this language
Hides the Imagine me button on posts and the Imagine option when you write a post or create a story. Everything else works as before.
column2: Menyembunyikan tombol Imagine me di postingan dan opsi Imagine saat menulis postingan atau membuat cerita. Yang lainnya berjalan seperti biasa.

column1: # context: summary of the switch that hides the other Meta AI buttons; these are buttons Facebook puts under some posts that open Meta AI; the next button is whatever other button the post would show there
Hides the other Meta AI buttons Facebook puts under posts. The post's next button shows instead, if it has one.
column2: Menyembunyikan tombol Meta AI lainnya yang dipasang Facebook di bawah postingan. Tombol berikutnya dari postingan tampil sebagai gantinya, jika ada.

column1: # context: label of a switch under Stories that replays a finished story; it works together with the Stop Story auto-advance switch
Loop stories
column2: Ulangi Cerita

column1: # context: summary of the Loop stories switch; "Stop Story auto-advance" is the label of the switch above it, so use its translation
With Stop Story auto-advance on, a finished story plays again from the start instead of waiting on its last frame. Tap or swipe to move on.
column2: Saat Hentikan perpindahan otomatis Cerita aktif, Cerita yang selesai diputar lagi dari awal, bukan berhenti di bingkai terakhirnya. Ketuk atau geser untuk lanjut.

column1: # context: label of a switch under Downloads that adds a Save photo item to the three-dot menu of posts with photos
Save photo in post menus
column2: Simpan foto di menu postingan

column1: # context: summary of the Save photo in post menus switch; "Save any photo" is the label of the switch above it and "Save photo" is the menu item, so use their translations
With Save any photo on, a post with photos gets Save photo in its three-dot menu too. A post with several saves each one, one after another.
column2: Saat Simpan foto apa pun aktif, postingan berisi foto juga mendapat Simpan foto di menu titik tiganya. Postingan dengan beberapa foto menyimpan semuanya satu per satu.

column1: # context: menu item in a post's three-dot menu that saves the post's one photo to the phone
Save photo
column2: Simpan foto

column1: # context: primary save row for a Story that reshares a Reel
Save video
column2: Simpan video

column1: # context: menu item in a post's three-dot menu that saves every photo of a post with several photos
Save all photos
column2: Simpan semua foto

column1: # context: short message shown when the photos of a post could not start saving
Couldn't save this post's photos. Try again in a moment.
column2: Foto postingan ini tidak dapat disimpan. Coba lagi sebentar lagi.

column1: # context: row in a comment's long-press sheet that saves the GIF the comment holds; keep it short like Save photo
Save GIF
column2: Simpan GIF

column1: # context: message after a tap on Save GIF when the save didn't start
Couldn't save this GIF. Try again in a moment.
column2: GIF ini tidak dapat disimpan. Coba lagi sebentar lagi.

column1: # context: sentence added after the summary of the Save any photo switch; Save GIF is the row's name, keep it as translated for that row
A GIF comment gets Save GIF when you long-press it.
column2: Tekan lama komentar GIF untuk memunculkan Simpan GIF.

column1: Couldn't save this story's photo. Try again in a moment.
column2: Foto cerita ini tidak dapat disimpan. Coba lagi sebentar lagi.

column1: Too many saves at once. Try again when one finishes.
column2: Terlalu banyak unduhan sekaligus. Coba lagi setelah salah satunya selesai.

column1: # context: settings switch under Block Instant Games ads that makes a game's rewarded ad count as watched
Answer rewarded game ads as watched
column2: Anggap iklan berhadiah game sudah ditonton

column1: # context: description under that switch
With Block Instant Games ads on, a game's rewarded ad counts as watched. No ad plays and the game still gives its reward.
column2: Saat “Blokir iklan Instant Games” menyala, iklan berhadiah di game dianggap sudah ditonton. Tidak ada iklan yang diputar dan game tetap memberi hadiahnya.

column1: # context: title of the list that picks the quality reels start at
Reels quality
column2: Kualitas reel

column1: # context: title of the list that picks the quality video stories start at
Stories quality
column2: Kualitas cerita

column1: # context: first choice in the Reels and Stories quality lists: follow the Default quality row
Same as default
column2: Sama dengan bawaan

column1: # context: summary of the Reels quality list when it follows the Playback quality row
Reels follow the Default quality row.
column2: Reel mengikuti baris Kualitas bawaan.

column1: # context: summary of the Stories quality list when it follows the Playback quality row
Video stories follow the Default quality row.
column2: Cerita video mengikuti baris Kualitas bawaan.

column1: # context: summary of the Reels quality list when it has a quality of its own; %1$s is that choice, such as Highest or Up to 720p
%1$s for reels, whatever Default quality is set to.
column2: %1$s untuk reel, apa pun setelan Kualitas bawaan.

column1: # context: summary of the Stories quality list when it has a quality of its own; %1$s is that choice, such as Highest or Up to 720p
%1$s for video stories, whatever Default quality is set to.
column2: %1$s untuk cerita video, apa pun setelan Kualitas bawaan.

column1: # context: title of the row naming a folder inside the save folder that video saves go in
Video subfolder
column2: Subfolder video

column1: # context: title of the row naming a folder inside the save folder that photo saves go in
Photo subfolder
column2: Subfolder foto

column1: # context: dialog text of the Video subfolder row
Choose a folder for videos inside the save folder. Invalid characters become underscores. Leave it blank to keep videos in the save folder itself.
column2: Pilih folder untuk video di dalam folder simpan. Karakter yang tidak valid menjadi garis bawah. Kosongkan agar video tetap di folder simpan itu sendiri.

column1: # context: dialog text of the Photo subfolder row
Choose a folder for photos inside the save folder. Invalid characters become underscores. Leave it blank to keep photos in the save folder itself.
column2: Pilih folder untuk foto di dalam folder simpan. Karakter yang tidak valid menjadi garis bawah. Kosongkan agar foto tetap di folder simpan itu sendiri.

column1: # context: summary of the Video subfolder row; %1$s is a folder path such as Movies/Facebook/Clips
Videos go to %1$s.
column2: Video disimpan ke %1$s.

column1: # context: summary of the Photo subfolder row; %1$s is a folder path such as Pictures/Facebook/Photos
Photos go to %1$s.
column2: Foto disimpan ke %1$s.

column1: # context: switch that takes the new-item dot and count off the Home tab
Hide the Home tab badge
column2: Sembunyikan lencana tab Beranda

column1: # context: switch that takes the new-item dot and count off the Friends tab
Hide the Friends tab badge
column2: Sembunyikan lencana tab Teman

column1: # context: switch that takes the new-item dot and count off the Marketplace tab
Hide the Marketplace tab badge
column2: Sembunyikan lencana tab Marketplace

column1: # context: switch that takes the new-item dot and count off the Notifications tab
Hide the Notifications tab badge
column2: Sembunyikan lencana tab Notifikasi

column1: # context: switch that takes the new-item dot and count off the Menu tab
Hide the Menu tab badge
column2: Sembunyikan lencana tab Menu

column1: # context: switch that takes the new-item dot and count off the Groups tab
Hide the Groups tab badge
column2: Sembunyikan lencana tab Grup

column1: # context: switch that takes the new-item dot and count off every tab without a switch of its own
Hide other tabs' badges
column2: Sembunyikan lencana tab lainnya

column1: # context: switch that keeps Facebook from putting its count on the launcher icon
Hide the app icon count
column2: Sembunyikan angka di ikon aplikasi

column1: # context: summary of the switch for the badges on every tab without a switch of its own
No dot or count on Feeds, Gaming, Events and the other tabs not listed here. The Reels tab has its own switch.
column2: Tanpa titik atau angka di Feed, Gaming, Acara, dan tab lain yang tidak tercantum di sini. Tab Reels punya tombolnya sendiri.

column1: # context: summary of each tab's badge switch
No dot or count on this tab. Its page still shows what's new when you open it.
column2: Tanpa titik atau angka di tab ini. Halamannya tetap menampilkan yang baru saat kamu membukanya.

column1: # context: summary of the app icon count switch
No number on Facebook's app icon. Notifications still arrive. Some launchers add their own count, which this can't remove.
column2: Tanpa angka di ikon Facebook. Notifikasi tetap masuk. Beberapa peluncur menambahkan hitungannya sendiri, dan itu tidak bisa dihapus di sini.

column1: # context: switch title under News feed; it shows posts and reel captions in their original language instead of Facebook's automatic translation
Turn off auto-translation
column2: Matikan terjemahan otomatis

column1: # context: description of that switch; See translation is the name of Facebook's own link under a post that translates it on request
Posts and reel captions stay in the language they were written in. Facebook's See translation link stays under them.
column2: Postingan dan keterangan reel tetap dalam bahasa aslinya. Tautan Lihat Terjemahan dari Facebook tetap ada di bawahnya.

column1: # context: switch title under Reels and Watch, below Keep the reel speed; it keeps a playback speed picked on a feed or Watch video for the next videos
Keep the video speed
column2: Pertahankan kecepatan video

column1: # context: description of that switch; the gear menu is the settings button on a video's player, where Playback speed is picked
The speed you pick in a feed or Watch video's menu carries over to the next videos. Reels keep their own speed. Off by default, since it hasn't been tried on a real account yet.
column2: Kecepatan yang kamu pilih di menu video feed atau Watch berlaku juga untuk video berikutnya. Reel punya kecepatannya sendiri. Mati secara bawaan, karena belum dicoba di akun sungguhan.

column1: # context: switch title under Downloads, below Download feed and Watch videos; it offers to download a reel or video whose link the user copied
Offer to download copied links
column2: Tawarkan unduhan untuk tautan yang disalin

column1: # context: description of that switch; Download feed and Watch videos is the name of the switch above it
With Download feed and Watch videos on, coming back to Facebook with a reel or video link copied offers to download it, once per link. Off, Facebook doesn't look at what you copied.
column2: Saat Unduh video dari Kabar Beranda dan Watch aktif, kembali ke Facebook dengan tautan reel atau video yang disalin akan menawarkan unduhannya, sekali per tautan. Saat nonaktif, Facebook tidak melihat apa yang kamu salin.

column1: # context: title of the dialog that offers to download the video whose link is on the clipboard; the link shows under it
Download the video you copied?
column2: Unduh video yang kamu salin?

column1: # context: button of that dialog that declines; the same link is never offered again
No thanks
column2: Tidak, terima kasih

column1: # context: toast when a copied share link couldn't be followed to a video, so Facebook opened the link itself
Couldn't find the video in that link, so it opened in Facebook instead.
column2: Video tidak ditemukan di tautan itu, jadi tautannya dibuka di Facebook.

column1: # context: toast when Download on a copied link opens the video first, so Facebook loads it and the save can start
Opening the video to save it
column2: Membuka video untuk menyimpannya

column1: # context: switch title under Stories, View stories anonymously's second switch; it adds an eye button over each story
Mark as seen button
column2: Tombol Tandai sudah dilihat

column1: # context: description of the Mark as seen button switch
Adds an eye button to the top of each story while you view anonymously. Tap it to show up on that story's viewer list. The other stories stay hidden.
column2: Menambahkan tombol mata di bagian atas setiap cerita saat kamu melihat secara anonim. Ketuk tombol itu agar kamu muncul di daftar penonton cerita tersebut. Cerita lainnya tetap tersembunyi.

column1: # context: what TalkBack reads for the eye button over a story while that story is still hidden from its viewer list
Mark as seen
column2: Tandai sudah dilihat

column1: # context: what TalkBack reads for the eye button once the story is marked and waiting to be sent; a second tap takes the mark back
Marked as seen. Tap again to undo.
column2: Ditandai sudah dilihat. Ketuk lagi untuk membatalkan.

column1: # context: what TalkBack reads for the eye button once the marked story was sent as seen
Marked as seen and sent
column2: Ditandai sudah dilihat dan dikirim

column1: # context: the word lists' dialogs, after their first paragraph: a line between slashes is a regular expression; %1$d is how many a list holds, %2$d the most characters each
A line between slashes, like /gr[ae]y/, is a pattern that can match several spellings (a regular expression). A list holds up to %1$d, each up to %2$d characters.
column2: Baris di antara garis miring, seperti /gr[ae]y/, adalah pola yang bisa cocok dengan beberapa ejaan (ekspresi reguler). Satu daftar memuat hingga %1$d, masing-masing hingga %2$d karakter.

column1: # context: under a word list being edited, and when its Save is refused: a line written between slashes isn't a pattern the app can read; %1$d is the line's number
Line %1$d isn't a pattern Hushfacebook can read. Fix it or remove it, then save again.
column2: Baris %1$d bukan pola yang bisa dibaca Hushfacebook. Perbaiki atau hapus, lalu simpan lagi.

column1: # context: under a word list being edited, and when its Save is refused: more patterns than a list holds; %1$d is the most a list holds
A list holds up to %1$d patterns, and this one has more. Remove some, then save again.
column2: Daftar memuat hingga %1$d pola, dan daftar ini lebih banyak. Hapus beberapa, lalu simpan lagi.

column1: # context: switch title: hides feed posts whose attachment is a photo or an album
Hide photo posts
column2: Sembunyikan postingan foto

column1: # context: switch title: hides feed posts whose attachment is a video
Hide video posts
column2: Sembunyikan postingan video

column1: # context: switch title: hides feed posts that share a link to a website
Hide link posts
column2: Sembunyikan postingan tautan

column1: # context: switch title: hides short text posts Facebook draws on a colored background
Hide posts on a colored background
column2: Sembunyikan postingan berlatar warna

column1: # context: summary of the Hide photo posts switch
Hides posts with a photo or album, including shares.
column2: Menyembunyikan postingan dengan foto atau album, termasuk yang dibagikan ulang.

column1: # context: summary of the Hide video posts switch
Hides posts with a video, including shares. Reels in the feed have their own switch.
column2: Menyembunyikan postingan dengan video, termasuk yang dibagikan ulang. Reel di feed punya sakelar sendiri.

column1: # context: summary of the Hide link posts switch
Hides posts that share a link to a website, with its preview card.
column2: Menyembunyikan postingan yang membagikan tautan ke situs web, beserta kartu pratinjaunya.

column1: # context: summary of the Hide posts on a colored background switch
Hides short posts shown as big text on a colored background.
column2: Menyembunyikan postingan pendek yang tampil sebagai teks besar di atas latar berwarna.

column1: # context: switch title under News feed: hides posts that share someone else's post, the ones Facebook heads "shared a post"; use Facebook's own word for a shared post in this language
Hide reposts
column2: Sembunyikan postingan yang dibagikan ulang

column1: # context: summary of the Hide reposts switch; a caption is what the sharer wrote above the shared post
Hides posts that share another post, with or without a caption. Original posts stay. Off by default, since it hasn't been tried on a real feed yet.
column2: Menyembunyikan postingan yang membagikan postingan lain, dengan atau tanpa keterangan. Postingan asli tetap ada. Mati secara bawaan, karena belum dicoba di feed sungguhan.

column1: Hide posts from Pages
column2: Sembunyikan postingan dari Halaman

column1: Hides posts written by Pages, the ones you follow too. Posts from friends and groups stay, and so does a friend's share of a Page's post.
column2: Menyembunyikan postingan yang ditulis Halaman, termasuk yang kamu ikuti. Postingan dari teman dan grup tetap ada, begitu juga postingan Halaman yang dibagikan teman.

column1: # context: switch title in Privacy: asks for the phone's own screen lock before Facebook shows
Lock Facebook
column2: Kunci Facebook

column1: Save crashes to Downloads
column2: Simpan crash ke Download

column1: When Facebook crashes, the error goes in a text file in Download/Hushfacebook, so you can send it with a bug report even if Facebook won't open. Links and IDs are left out. The newest five are kept.
column2: Saat Facebook crash, errornya disimpan sebagai file teks di Download/Hushfacebook, jadi kamu bisa mengirimnya bersama laporan bug meski Facebook tidak mau terbuka. Tautan dan ID tidak disertakan. Lima file terbaru disimpan.

column1: # context: switch title in Privacy: Facebook quits fully a few seconds after you switch away from it
Close Facebook when you leave it
column2: Tutup Facebook saat kamu keluar

column1: A few seconds after you leave Facebook, it closes all the way and leaves your recent apps, so it isn't running in the background. It waits for uploads and saves to finish first. Notifications may come late, or not until you open Facebook again.
column2: Beberapa detik setelah kamu keluar dari Facebook, aplikasi ini tertutup sepenuhnya dan hilang dari aplikasi terbaru, jadi tidak berjalan di latar belakang. Unggahan dan penyimpanan diselesaikan dulu. Notifikasi bisa datang terlambat atau baru muncul saat kamu membuka Facebook lagi.

column1: # context: summary of the Lock Facebook switch; the time below is the Lock after row under it
Facebook asks for your fingerprint, face or screen lock at startup and when you return after the time below. Your phone needs a screen lock.
column2: Facebook meminta sidik jari, wajah, atau kunci layar saat dibuka dan saat kamu kembali setelah waktu di bawah. Ponselmu perlu kunci layar.

column1: # context: toast when Lock Facebook is turned on and the phone has no screen lock to ask for
Set a screen lock in your phone's settings first, so Facebook has something to ask for.
column2: Atur kunci layar di setelan ponsel Anda terlebih dahulu, agar Facebook punya sesuatu untuk diminta.

column1: # context: title of the row and list that picks how long Facebook may be away before it locks
Lock after
column2: Kunci setelah

column1: # context: Lock after choice: Facebook locks the moment you leave it
As soon as you leave
column2: Begitu Anda keluar

column1: # context: Lock after choice, and the %1$s of the lock sentences: a minute away
1 minute
column2: 1 menit

column1: # context: Lock after choice, and the %1$s of the lock sentences: five minutes away
5 minutes
column2: 5 menit

column1: # context: Lock after choice, and the %1$s of the lock sentences: fifteen minutes away
15 minutes
column2: 15 menit

column1: # context: Lock after choice, and the %1$s of the lock sentences: an hour away
1 hour
column2: 1 jam

column1: # context: summary of the Lock after row when it locks the moment you leave
Facebook locks as soon as you leave it.
column2: Facebook terkunci begitu Anda keluar.

column1: # context: summary of the Lock after row; %1$s is a time such as 5 minutes
Facebook locks once you've been away for %1$s.
column2: Facebook terkunci setelah Anda pergi selama %1$s.

column1: # context: what a settings import changes: the lock will happen the moment Facebook is left
With Lock Facebook on, it will lock as soon as you leave it.
column2: Dengan Kunci Facebook aktif, Facebook akan terkunci begitu Anda keluar.

column1: # context: what a settings import changes; %1$s is a time such as 5 minutes
With Lock Facebook on, it will lock once you've been away for %1$s.
column2: Dengan Kunci Facebook aktif, Facebook akan terkunci setelah Anda pergi selama %1$s.

column1: # context: title of Android's fingerprint, face or screen lock prompt that Lock Facebook shows
Unlock Facebook
column2: Buka kunci Facebook

column1: # context: title on the screen that covers Facebook until the screen lock check passes
Facebook is locked
column2: Facebook terkunci

column1: # context: text under it on the cover
Use your fingerprint, face or screen lock to open it.
column2: Gunakan sidik jari, wajah, atau kunci layar Anda untuk membukanya.

column1: # context: button on the cover that asks for the screen lock again
Unlock
column2: Buka kunci

column1: # context: title of the row and list that picks how large Facebook's text is, as a share of the phone's font size
Text size
column2: Ukuran teks

column1: # context: Text size choice for no change: Facebook's text stays at the size the phone's font size setting gives it
As Facebook has it
column2: Seperti di Facebook

column1: # context: summary of the Text size row at its default
Facebook's text is the size your phone's font size setting gives it.
column2: Teks Facebook berukuran sesuai pengaturan ukuran font di ponselmu.

# context: row on the Pause, backup and diagnostics page; shows or hides the Quick setups row on the settings home page
# context: name of a Quick setups choice that hides ads and nags; an adjective, as in a quiet feed
Quiet
column2: Tenang

column1: Hides ads, suggestions, promos and prompts, and stops nagging notifications.
column2: Menyembunyikan iklan, saran, promosi, dan ajakan, serta menghentikan notifikasi yang mengganggu.

column1: # context: what the Privacy choice of Quick setups turns on; camera roll scans are Hold back camera roll processing
Holds back usage reports and camera roll scans, removes link tracking, and hides your typing and screenshots.
column2: Menahan laporan penggunaan dan pemindaian rol kamera, menghapus pelacakan tautan, serta menyembunyikan status mengetik dan tangkapan layar Anda.

column1: # context: name of the Quick setups choice that puts the switches back as they were after install
Back to defaults
column2: Kembali ke bawaan

column1: # context: Lock Facebook is the name of the app lock switch, left as it is
Puts every feature switch but Lock Facebook back the way it started.
column2: Mengembalikan setiap sakelar fitur kecuali Kunci Facebook seperti semula.

column1: # context: toast after a Quick setups choice changed one switch
Changed %1$d setting
column2: %1$d pengaturan diubah

column1: # context: the same toast for none, or for two or more
Changed %1$d settings
column2: %1$d pengaturan diubah

column1: # context: toast and Last save row: a save failed for want of a connection
The connection failed. Check your internet and try again.
column2: Koneksi gagal. Periksa internetmu lalu coba lagi.

column1: # context: toast and Last save row: the server answered a save with an error, not the file
Facebook's server didn't send the file. Try again in a moment.
column2: Server Facebook tidak mengirim filenya. Coba lagi sebentar lagi.

column1: # context: toast and Last save row: the file a save fetched came empty or cut short
The download ended before the whole file arrived. Try again.
column2: Unduhan berhenti sebelum seluruh file tiba. Coba lagi.

column1: # context: toast and Last save row: a save's work file couldn't be written, for a reason the phone didn't give
Your phone couldn't write the file. Check your free space and try again.
column2: Ponselmu tidak bisa menulis filenya. Periksa ruang kosongnya lalu coba lagi.

column1: # context: toast and Last save row: the phone was measured and has too little free space for a save
Not enough free space to save this. Free some up and try again.
column2: Ruang kosong tidak cukup untuk menyimpan ini. Kosongkan sedikit lalu coba lagi.

column1: # context: toast and Last save row: a video's picture and sound couldn't be converted or joined; Download quality is the setting's name
Your phone couldn't put this video together. Try another Download quality.
column2: Ponselmu tidak bisa menyusun video ini. Coba Kualitas unduhan yang lain.

column1: # context: toast and Last save row: the gallery refused a finished photo or video
The file couldn't be copied into your phone's gallery. Try again in a moment.
column2: File tidak bisa disalin ke galeri ponselmu. Coba lagi sebentar lagi.

column1: # context: title of a switch on the Menu settings page: whether the Hushfacebook settings shortcut shows when you hold Facebook's launcher icon
Settings shortcut on the app icon
column2: Pintasan pengaturan di ikon aplikasi

column1: # context: title of a switch on the Menu settings page: whether a long press on the Facebook logo opens the Hushfacebook settings
Open settings from the logo
column2: Buka pengaturan dari logo

column1: # context: title of a switch on the Menu settings page: whether the Hushfacebook settings row shows at the end of Settings and privacy in Facebook's Menu
Settings row in Menu
column2: Baris pengaturan di Menu

column1: # context: summary of the switch for the Hushfacebook settings shortcut in the launcher icon's menu
Puts Hushfacebook settings in the menu you get by holding Facebook's icon. Off, it leaves that menu.
column2: Menaruh Pengaturan Hushfacebook di menu yang muncul saat ikon Facebook ditekan lama. Jika dimatikan, pintasan itu hilang dari menu tersebut.

column1: # context: summary of the switch for opening the settings with a long press on the Facebook logo
A long press on the Facebook logo at the top of the home feed opens these settings. Off, the long press goes back to Facebook.
column2: Menekan lama logo Facebook di bagian atas beranda membuka pengaturan ini. Jika dimatikan, tekan lama itu kembali menjadi milik Facebook.

column1: # context: summary of the switch for the Hushfacebook settings row in Facebook's Menu
Adds a Hushfacebook settings row at the end of Settings and privacy in Facebook's Menu. Off, the row leaves the Menu.
column2: Menambahkan baris Pengaturan Hushfacebook di akhir Pengaturan dan privasi pada Menu Facebook. Jika dimatikan, baris itu hilang dari Menu.

column1: # context: summary shown instead of a switch's usual one while it is the only one of the three ways into the settings still on, so it is greyed out
The last way into these settings stays on.
column2: Cara terakhir untuk membuka pengaturan ini tetap menyala.

column1: # context: switch title on the Appearance settings page: hides Facebook Flex's Data mode bar under the top bar; Data mode is Facebook's own name for paid mode on Flex carriers
Hide the Data mode banner
column2: Sembunyikan banner Mode Data

column1: # context: switch title on the Appearance settings page: hides Facebook Flex's purple Free mode bar; Free mode is Facebook's own name for the free text-only mode
Hide the Free mode banner
column2: Sembunyikan banner Mode Gratis

column1: # context: summary of the Hide the Data mode banner switch
On carriers with Facebook Flex, hides the Data mode bar under the top bar and its button to buy mobile data.
column2: Di operator dengan Facebook Flex, menyembunyikan bilah Mode Data di bawah bilah atas beserta tombolnya untuk membeli data seluler.

column1: # context: summary of the Hide the Free mode banner switch; the purple bar is also where you switch back to Data mode
On carriers with Facebook Flex, hides the purple Free mode bar. That bar is also how you go back to Data mode, so turn this off when you want to switch.
column2: Di operator dengan Facebook Flex, menyembunyikan bilah ungu Mode Gratis. Bilah itu juga cara kembali ke Mode Data, jadi matikan ini saat kamu ingin beralih.

column1: # context: switch title under Picture-in-picture on the Playback page: the small window opens only from the Picture-in-picture row this adds to a reel's three-dot More menu, not when you leave Facebook
Only from a reel's More menu
column2: Hanya dari menu reel

column1: # context: summary of that switch; Picture-in-picture is the name of the row in the reel's menu, translated as the row is; the three dots are the reel's own menu button
Leaving Facebook doesn't open the window. Tap Picture-in-picture in a reel's More menu (the three dots) when you want one. That row shows on upright reels, not wide ones.
column2: Keluar dari Facebook tidak membuka jendela. Ketuk Gambar dalam gambar di menu reel (tiga titik) saat kamu menginginkannya. Baris itu ada di reel tegak, bukan di reel lebar.

column1: # context: switch title under Picture-in-picture on the Playback page; the button floats over a reel or video and opens the small window when tapped
Picture-in-picture button
column2: Tombol gambar dalam gambar

column1: # context: summary of that switch; "the window" is the small picture-in-picture window
Shows a small button at the left edge of a reel or video that has the window ready. Tap it to open the window right away. Works with Picture-in-picture on.
column2: Menampilkan tombol kecil di tepi kiri reel atau video yang jendelanya sudah siap. Ketuk untuk langsung membuka jendela. Berfungsi saat Gambar dalam gambar aktif.

column1: # context: switch title under Stories; it makes videos you post to your own Story ask for high quality when they upload
Upload Stories in HD
column2: Unggah cerita dalam HD

column1: # context: summary of that switch; standard is the normal upload quality, high the better one
Videos you post to your Story ask Facebook for its high upload quality instead of standard. Applies to the next Story you post.
column2: Video yang Anda posting ke cerita Anda meminta kualitas unggahan tinggi dari Facebook, bukan standar. Berlaku untuk cerita berikutnya yang Anda posting.

column1: # context: switch title under Stories; a photo story is a still picture posted to your own Story, and a song added to it plays while the picture shows
Longer music on photo stories
column2: Musik lebih panjang di cerita foto

column1: # context: summary of that switch; 15 seconds is how long Facebook lets the song on a photo play, and the song's length can be shorter than 30
A song you add to a photo for your Story plays for up to 30 seconds instead of 15. Applies to the next song you pick.
column2: Lagu yang Anda tambahkan ke foto untuk cerita Anda diputar hingga 30 detik, bukan 15. Berlaku untuk lagu berikutnya yang Anda pilih.

column1: # context: switch title under Stories; two fingers spread apart on a story or a profile photo make it bigger
Pinch to zoom
column2: Cubit untuk zoom

column1: # context: summary of that switch; "let go" means lifting your fingers off the screen
Pinch a story or a photo on someone's profile to zoom in. It goes back when you let go.
column2: Cubit cerita atau foto di profil seseorang untuk memperbesarnya. Kembali seperti semula saat kamu melepaskan jari.

column1: # context: switch title under Stories, right below Pinch to zoom; the zoomed picture stays zoomed after the fingers lift
Stay zoomed
column2: Tetap diperbesar

column1: # context: summary of that switch; "Pinch to zoom" is the label of the switch above it, so use its translation; "Back" is the phone's Back button
With Pinch to zoom on, the photo or story stays zoomed when you let go, and a story stays paused. Drag with one finger or pinch again. Tap or press Back when you're done.
column2: Saat Cubit untuk zoom aktif, foto atau cerita tetap diperbesar saat kamu melepaskan jari, dan cerita tetap dijeda. Geser dengan satu jari atau cubit lagi. Ketuk atau tekan Kembali kalau sudah selesai.

column1: # context: switch title under Stories, right below Stay zoomed; two quick taps on a photo zoom it in where you tapped
Double tap to zoom
column2: Ketuk dua kali untuk zoom

column1: # context: summary of that switch; "Pinch to zoom" is the label of the switch two rows above it, so use its translation; a story is the full-screen picture or video someone shares for a day
With Pinch to zoom on, double tap a photo on a profile to zoom in where you tapped, and double tap again to put it back. A single tap still opens the photo, a moment later.
column2: Saat Cubit untuk zoom aktif, ketuk dua kali foto di profil untuk memperbesar di tempat yang kamu ketuk, lalu ketuk dua kali lagi untuk mengembalikannya. Ketuk sekali tetap membuka foto, hanya sesaat lebih lambat.

column2: Tanpa iklan yang diunduh lebih dulu

column2: Tanpa pelacakan iklan

column2: Iklan Facebook di aplikasi lain

column1: Part of the Reels ad blocking
column2: Sebagian pemblokiran iklan di Reels

column2: Perbaikan saat mulai untuk ponsel x86

column1: Version number Google Play sees
column2: Nomor versi yang dilihat Google Play

column1: Hushfacebook in the Menu
column2: Hushfacebook di Menu

column2: Diatur saat menambal, jadi Jeda tidak dapat mematikannya:\n%1$s\nUntuk memastikan bukan ini penyebabnya, tambal ulang tanpa tambalannya.

column1: Set when you patched, so Pause can't turn these off:\n%1$s\nTo rule one out, patch again and leave out its patch.
column2: Diatur saat menambal, jadi Jeda tidak dapat mematikannya:\n%1$s\nUntuk memastikan salah satunya bukan penyebabnya, tambal ulang tanpa tambalannya.

column2: Untuk saat Hanya Marketplace atau Hanya Acara aktif. Sekarang keduanya tidak aktif.

column1: Hide the Meta AI shortcut
column2: Sembunyikan pintasan Meta AI

column1: The Meta AI shortcut leaves the Menu's list with Feeds, Marketplace, Reels and Groups, and the next shortcut moves up into its place.
column2: Pintasan Meta AI hilang dari daftar di Menu bersama Feed, Marketplace, Reels, dan Grup, dan pintasan berikutnya naik ke tempatnya.

column1: Hide people to send to in the share sheet
column2: Sembunyikan orang yang disarankan saat berbagi

column1: Takes the row of profile pictures off the share sheet, the people Facebook suggests sending a post to. The search box and the other ways to share stay.
column2: Menghapus deretan foto profil dari lembar berbagi, yaitu orang-orang yang disarankan Facebook untuk dikirimi kiriman. Kotak pencarian dan cara berbagi lainnya tetap ada.

column1: Hide who is typing in comments
column2: Sembunyikan siapa yang sedang mengetik di komentar

column1: Takes away the line that says someone is typing a comment. Your own typing is a separate switch under Privacy.
column2: Menghapus baris yang menunjukkan seseorang sedang mengetik komentar. Saat Anda sendiri mengetik punya sakelar terpisah di Privasi.

column1: Hide the search pill on reels
column2: Sembunyikan saran pencarian di reel

column1: Hides the search suggestion under a reel's caption, the magnifier with a question to look up, the one at the top of its comments and the search bar over reels you open from a profile.
column2: Menyembunyikan saran pencarian di bawah keterangan reel, ikon kaca pembesar dengan pertanyaan untuk dicari, yang ada di atas komentarnya, dan bilah pencarian di atas reel yang Anda buka dari sebuah profil.

column1: Hide the top right buttons on opened videos
column2: Sembunyikan tombol kanan atas di video yang dibuka

column1: Takes Search and the button next to it off the top of a video or reel you open. Back stays, and so does More at the bottom of the side buttons, where Download is.
column2: Menghapus Cari dan tombol di sebelahnya dari bagian atas video atau reel yang kamu buka. Kembali tetap ada, begitu juga Lainnya di bawah tombol samping, tempat Unduh berada.

column1: # context: switch title under Appearance; the button is Facebook's Messenger icon in the top bar of Home
Hide the Messenger button
column2: Sembunyikan tombol Messenger

column1: # context: summary of that switch; the other top bar buttons move over to fill the space; Hushfacebook is the app's name
Takes the Messenger button out of the top bar, and the buttons beside it close up the gap. Restart Facebook to see the change.
column2: Menghapus tombol Messenger dari bilah atas, dan tombol di sebelahnya bergeser menutup celah. Mulai ulang Facebook untuk melihat perubahannya.

column1: # context: switch title under Appearance; the count is the unread number badge on the Messenger icon
Hide the Messenger count
column2: Sembunyikan hitungan Messenger

column1: # context: summary of that switch; the Messenger icon stays in the top bar
Keeps the Messenger button but drops the unread count on it.
column2: Tombol Messenger tetap ada, tetapi angka pesan yang belum dibaca di atasnya disembunyikan.

column1: # context: switch title under Appearance; the logo is the Facebook wordmark or icon at the left of the top bar
Hide the Facebook logo
column2: Sembunyikan logo Facebook

column1: # context: summary of that switch; Hushfacebook is the app's name and stays as it is; press and hold is a long press
Hides the Facebook logo in the top bar. The empty spot is the same size and still opens Hushfacebook settings when you press and hold it. Restart Facebook to see the change.
column2: Menyembunyikan logo Facebook di bilah atas. Ruang kosongnya berukuran sama dan tetap membuka pengaturan Hushfacebook saat ditekan lama. Mulai ulang Facebook untuk melihat perubahannya.

column1: Hide the Create button
column2: Sembunyikan tombol Buat

column1: Takes the + button for making a post, reel or story out of the top bar. Restart Facebook to see the change.
column2: Menghapus tombol + untuk membuat postingan, reel, dan cerita dari bilah atas. Mulai ulang Facebook untuk melihat perubahannya.

column1: Hide the search button
column2: Sembunyikan tombol cari

column1: Takes the search button out of the top bar. Restart Facebook to see the change.
column2: Menghapus tombol cari dari bilah atas. Mulai ulang Facebook untuk melihat perubahannya.

column1: Search with a picture
column2: Cari dengan gambar

column1: Press and hold the search button to open Google Lens, then point the camera at something or pick a picture to find out what it is. The picture goes to Google, not Facebook. Restart Facebook to see the change.
column2: Tekan lama tombol cari untuk membuka Google Lens, lalu arahkan kamera ke sesuatu atau pilih gambar untuk mengetahui apa itu. Gambar dikirim ke Google, bukan Facebook. Mulai ulang Facebook untuk melihat perubahannya.

column1: No app on this phone can open Google Lens
column2: Tidak ada aplikasi di ponsel ini yang bisa membuka Google Lens

column1: # context: switch title under News feed; the counts are the numbers on the Like, Comment and Share buttons under a post
Hide counts on posts
column2: Sembunyikan angka di postingan

column1: # context: summary of that switch; Like, Comment and Share are Facebook's own button labels, so use Facebook's wording in your language
Takes the numbers off the Like, Comment and Share buttons under posts, so each shows just its word. The buttons stay where they are. A change shows on the posts drawn after it.
column2: Menghapus angka dari tombol Suka, Komentari, dan Bagikan di bawah postingan, sehingga tiap tombol hanya menampilkan katanya. Tombol tetap di tempatnya. Perubahan terlihat pada postingan yang dimuat setelahnya.

column1: # context: switch title under Reels and Watch; the counts are the numbers under the Like, Comment and Share icons down a reel's right side
Hide counts on reels
column2: Sembunyikan angka di reel

column1: # context: summary of that switch; Like, Comment and Share are Facebook's own button labels, so use Facebook's wording in your language
Takes the numbers away from under a reel's Like, Comment and Share icons. The icons stay where they are. A change shows from the next reel.
column2: Menghapus angka di bawah ikon Suka, Komentari, dan Bagikan pada reel. Ikon tetap di tempatnya. Perubahan terlihat mulai reel berikutnya.

column1: # context: Reels and Watch switch for the dedicated WhatsApp sidebar button, independent of the Share menu
Hide WhatsApp on reels
column2: Sembunyikan WhatsApp di reel

column1: Hides the WhatsApp button beside reels and videos. WhatsApp stays in the Share menu. A change shows from the next video.
column2: Menyembunyikan tombol WhatsApp di samping reel dan video. WhatsApp tetap ada di menu Bagikan. Perubahan berlaku mulai video berikutnya.

column1: # context: switch title under Reels and Watch; Like is Facebook's own label for that button down a reel's right side, so use Facebook's wording in your language
Hide Like on reels
column2: Sembunyikan Suka di reel

column1: # context: switch title under Reels and Watch; Comment is Facebook's own label for that button down a reel's right side, so use Facebook's wording in your language
Hide Comment on reels
column2: Sembunyikan Komentari di reel

column1: # context: switch title under Reels and Watch; Share is Facebook's own label for that button down a reel's right side, so use Facebook's wording in your language
Hide Share on reels
column2: Sembunyikan Bagikan di reel

column1: # context: summary shared by the Like, Comment and Share switches on reels
Takes this button off the side of reels. The buttons above it move down. A change shows from the next reel.
column2: Menghapus tombol ini dari sisi reel. Tombol di atasnya turun. Perubahan terlihat mulai reel berikutnya.

column1: # context: switch title under Reels and Watch; Save is Facebook's own label for the bookmark button down a reel's right side, so use Facebook's wording in your language
Hide Save on reels
column2: Sembunyikan Simpan di reel

column1: # context: summary of that switch; the buttons under it are Download and More
Takes the Save button off the side of reels. The buttons above it move down. A change shows from the next reel.
column2: Menghapus tombol Simpan dari sisi reel. Tombol di atasnya turun. Perubahan terlihat mulai reel berikutnya.

column1: # context: switch title under Reels and Watch; the speaker is the sound on and off button at the bottom of the row of buttons down a reel's right side
Hide the speaker button on reels
column2: Sembunyikan tombol speaker di reel

column1: # context: summary of that switch
Takes the speaker button off the bottom of the side of reels. A change shows from the next reel.
column2: Menghapus tombol speaker dari bagian bawah sisi reel. Perubahan terlihat mulai reel berikutnya.

column1: Move the speaker above the three dots
column2: Pindahkan speaker ke atas tiga titik

column1: Puts the speaker button in the side column of reels, right above the three dots. A change shows from the next reel.
column2: Menaruh tombol speaker di kolom samping reel, tepat di atas tiga titik. Perubahan terlihat mulai reel berikutnya.

column1: # context: switch title under News feed; the reaction preview is the stack of reaction icons and the line with the number of reactions under a post
Hide the reaction preview on posts
column2: Sembunyikan pratinjau reaksi di postingan

column1: # context: summary of that switch; "reactions" are Facebook's Like, Love, Haha and other reactions

Hides the stacked reaction icons and the reactions count under posts. The space stays, so a tap where they were still opens the list of reactions. To take the number off the Like button too, turn on Hide counts on posts.
column2: Menyembunyikan ikon reaksi yang bertumpuk dan jumlah reaksi di bawah postingan. Ruangnya tetap ada, jadi mengetuk di tempat semula tetap membuka daftar reaksi. Untuk menghapus juga angka di tombol Suka, aktifkan Sembunyikan angka di postingan.

column1: # context: switch title under Comments; the reaction preview is the stack of reaction icons in the corner of a comment
Hide the reaction preview on comments
column2: Sembunyikan pratinjau reaksi di komentar

column1: # context: summary of that switch; "reactions" are Facebook's Like, Love, Haha and other reactions
Hides the stacked reaction icons in the corner of a comment. The space stays, so a tap where they were still opens the list of reactions.
column2: Menyembunyikan ikon reaksi yang bertumpuk di sudut komentar. Ruangnya tetap ada, jadi mengetuk di tempat semula tetap membuka daftar reaksi.

column1: # context: switch title under Downloads; "Download" is the post menu row "Download to phone" and "post menus" are the three-dot menus under posts
Download first in post menus
column2: Unduh di urutan pertama menu kiriman

column1: # context: summary of that switch; "Download to phone" and "Save photo" are the menu rows, translate them as elsewhere; "More options" is the title of Facebook's own page, use Facebook's wording

Moves Download to phone and Save photo from the end of a post's three-dot menu to the start of its options list. Facebook's own top rows stay above them (on photo posts the list is the More options page). A post with nothing to save gets neither.
column2: Memindahkan Unduh ke ponsel dan Simpan foto dari bagian bawah menu tiga titik sebuah kiriman ke awal daftar opsinya. Baris teratas milik Facebook tetap di atasnya (pada kiriman foto, daftarnya adalah halaman Opsi lainnya). Kiriman tanpa sesuatu untuk disimpan tidak mendapat keduanya.

Menu tiles to hide
column2: Ubin Menu yang disembunyikan

Hide from the Menu

Help and support: %s

Settings and privacy: %s

Your list of Menu tiles to hide will be empty.

Your list of Menu tiles to hide will hold %1$d tile.
